verdict.rationale: This product is a library of 'skill' files/prompts installed into existing AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot); it is not itself an agent runtime or tool-server that connects to MCP servers — any MCP tool usage would be a function of the host agent, not this skills package. No evidence in the pack even mentions MCP, confirming this axis is outside the product's category.
